题目.题目4:

题干：Each student has one ______.
考点：易混
题目.题目5:

题干：The election were held on Sunday.
题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：An election is ______.
A. one vote
B. a speech
C. a party
D. the whole process of voting
考点：易混
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：A general election chooses ______.
A. a teacher
B. a dog
C. a book
D. a government
考点：短语
题目.答案:
【1】A（选举）
讲解：election 选举。
【2】A（election）
讲解：the 后面要名词 election。
【3】elect
讲解：will 后面用动词原形 elect。
【4】vote
讲解：一张“选票”用 vote；election 是整个选举。
【5】were → was
讲解：主语 election 单数，谓语用 was。
【6】D（the whole process of voting）
讲解：election 是投票选人的整个过程。
【7】D（a government）
讲解：general election 大选。
